table.title: Image inside a numbered list item

entry.codeblock: 1. Open the Alarm Configuration page. ![Alarm Configuration Page](images/alarm-config-page.png) 2. Configure the notification settings. 3. Click **Save**.

<steps> <step> <cmd>Open the Alarm Configuration page.</cmd> <info> <image href="media/alarm-config-page.png"> <alt>Alarm Configuration Page</alt> </image> </info> </step> <step> <cmd>Configure the notification settings.</cmd> </step> <step> <cmd>Click <uicontrol>Save</uicontrol>.</cmd> </step> </steps>

section.p: Result: The converter associates the image with the preceding ordered list item and places it within the corresponding DITA step. The image becomes supporting information for that step and is contained within an <info> element inside the <step>.
